findings.current: During the Great Faction War, they ran wild like reckless fools, never knowing their place. They died without even recognizing the true Heaven—and went so far as to raise their swords against it.
findings.defect: The source gives two alternatives: they died after running wild, or they raised their swords against the true Heaven. The draft makes both happen to the same men.
findings.rationale: The connective 죽거나 marks the first fate as an alternative to the second.
findings.replacement: During the Great Faction War, they either ran wild like reckless fools who didn’t know their place and got themselves killed, or failed to recognize the true Heaven and raised their swords against it.
findings.source: 정마대전에서 제 분수도 모른 채 천둥벌거숭이처럼 날뛰다가 죽거나, 진정한 하늘을 제대로 알아보지 못하고 되레 칼을 들이댔으니.

findings.current: That’s not something even someone with many years of experience could know.
findings.defect: Omits the pointed claim that having such an experienced person beside Taekyung would not help.
findings.rationale: 곁에 있다 해도 means ‘even if [that person] were at your side,’ following the Blood-Sword Demon Lord’s glance between Taekyung and Jeok Cheongang.
findings.replacement: Even with someone who’s spent many years gaining experience at your side, you couldn’t have learned those names.
findings.source: 이건 설령 오랜 세월 동안 경륜을 쌓은 누군가가 곁에 있다 해도 알 수 없는 부분이야.

findings.current: Qi Sense, now at Rank Nine, spread out from me,
findings.defect: Turns nine-tenths mastery into a numbered rank.
findings.rationale: 구성 here describes the technique’s degree of attainment, not a Rank Nine classification.
findings.replacement: Qi Sense, now nine-tenths mastered, spread out from me,
findings.source: 어느덧 구성에 다다른 [기감]이 나를 중심으로 뻗어 나가

findings.current: A spell charged with Will manifested in the Blood-Sword Demon Lord’s body.
findings.defect: Capitalized Will identifies a specific System attribute that the source does not identify as powering this spell.
findings.rationale: 의지를 담은 describes intent put into the incantation; it does not establish the System attribute Will as the mechanism.
findings.replacement: A spell imbued with intent manifested in the Blood-Sword Demon Lord’s body.
findings.source: 의지를 담은 주문이, 혈검마군의 몸으로 발현(發現)했다.

findings.current: And at the moment those two words, so familiar and yet so unbelievable, slipped from between my lips—
findings.defect: Calls “Magic” two words, though the English utterance is one word.
findings.rationale: 두 글자 counts the Korean word’s two syllabic characters; the translated utterance is one English word.
findings.replacement: And at the moment that one word, so familiar and yet so unbelievable, slipped from between my lips—
findings.source: 더없이 익숙하면서도, 믿을 수 없는 그 두 글자가 입술 사이를 비집고 흘러나온 그 순간.

summary: The draft changes a key either-or account of the Black Ghosts’ past, turns Qi Sense’s degree of mastery into a rank, and mistakes ordinary intent for the System attribute Will. System panels also retain forbidden brackets.
